description.zh:
IPC设备的IotId列表。IotId是物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。

可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。
description.en:
The list of IotId values of IPC devices. An IotId is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device.

You can call the [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) operation of IoT Platform to query the IotId.
